baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same subject governs the past first enlivening and the two thumma-linked imperfect verbs at words 3, 5, and 7, before the emphatic predicate at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: One agent originates animate life, removes it, and restores it; continuity of agency makes the phases a controlled sequence rather than unrelated events, while kafur names the recipient's contradictory response.

activation_trace.role: Animate life supplies both poles of the sequence and makes their recurrence an enacted restoration.
Loss of force and life supplies the real interruption governed by the same subject.
The visibly human creature is the collective recipient brought under the three-stage agency.
Covering a benefaction turns the final predicate into ingratitude for the entire administered sequence.

changed_reading.before: A bare chronological claim that humans live, die, and will live again.
changed_reading.after: A compact sovereignty argument: every threshold belongs to one giver, so ingratitude denies not one gift but the coherence of the whole sequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative life-death-life verbs at words 3, 5, and 7 permit attention to the production, withdrawal, and return of effective capacity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The death inventory includes deliberate weakening of force, while life includes benefit and good; together they expose creaturely capacity as something applied, reduced, and restored rather than self-owned.

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit and good makes enlivening the grant of effective, useful capacity.
Caused weakening or removal of force makes death the withdrawal phase of that capacity.
Literal covering functions as concealment of the dependence revealed by each modulation.

changed_reading.before: Life and death are only remote biological endpoints.
changed_reading.after: The endpoints also disclose an ongoing economy of borrowed force: useful capacity is given, can be withdrawn, and can be restored.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of al-insan at word 9 and emphatic la-kafur at word 10 makes the kind of creature and its response collide.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human root inventory activates sensing and recognition, while kufr activates covering and veiling truth; the indictment becomes a reversal in which a creature equipped to notice the sequence covers what it can apprehend.

activation_trace.role: Perception by sight, hearing, or inward sensing supplies the human capacity to register the life-death-life sign.
Covering supplies the contrary operation performed upon what perception makes available.
Veiling or rejecting truth gives the perceptual reversal its specifically epistemic force.

changed_reading.before: Human is merely the generic subject of an ingratitude statement.
changed_reading.after: Human becomes a paradoxical perceiver-coverer whose failure consists in occluding a pattern the creature is fitted to recognize.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The life-death-life frame at words 3, 5, and 7 converges with the polyvalent kafur at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Focus branches alone align living land by rain, dead uncultivated land, the farmer who covers seed, and the sheath that covers fruit. This yields a latent cultivation cycle in which covering can hide either a gift or germinating life.

activation_trace.role: Earth living by rain and vegetation gives the two life verbs an ecological material image.
Dead uncultivated land supplies the dormant middle state between two manifestations of life.
The farmer's covering of seed supplies the surprising lexical hinge between concealment and later emergence.
A fruit sheath literalizes covering that temporarily conceals developing life.

changed_reading.before: Kafur is only an abstract moral label appended to a resurrection sequence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse also forms a cultivation lattice: apparent death and covering can contain latent life, while culpable covering refuses to acknowledge its giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet places dry lifeless earth, delivered water, movement, growth, and greenness in the same argument as human coming-to-life. These material transitions strongly activate the focus's ecological life and dead-land branches; the farmer sense of kafur remains a contained lexical resonance.

activation_trace.role: Rain-vivified earth supplies the focus's ecological life poles.
Dead or uncultivated land supplies the intervening dormancy.
Dryness in which life is absent gives the context an explicit material death-state.
Water delivered by irrigation supplies the enabling medium for reversal.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life marks the first visible activation after dormancy.
Plant emergence from earth supplies the completed return from hidden potential to manifest life.
Fresh green vegetation compresses the same revival mechanism near the focus.
Seed-covering by a farmer makes kafur an ironic echo of the process without replacing its moral sense.

structural_cues: 22:5 places human gestation and dry-earth revival inside one proof sequence.
22:63 compresses descending water and a green-earth result shortly before the focus.
The focus repeats life around death, matching dormant-to-emergent reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dormancy, water, movement, growth, and greenness; I infer that this ecological sequence is a material analogue for the focus's life-death-life cycle. The live alternative is that it evidences resurrection without coloring kafur through cultivation.

changed_reading.before: The focus presents only a human biological and eschatological sequence.
changed_reading.after: The human sequence coexists with a visibly supported ecology of latency: death can resemble fallow concealment from which given life emerges again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, making animals serviceable explicitly aims at gratitude; immediately before the focus, the same service extends through earth, ship-flow, restraint of the sky, and compassion. Life, death, and revived life become the culminating instance of continuously administered dependence, and kafur reverses the expected shukr response.

activation_trace.role: Making a creature tractable for a purpose establishes beneficent service as a contextual pattern.
Recognition of benefit and praise of its giver states the response expected from administered service.
Earthly things directed to human use extend service from ritual provision to the whole environment.
Actual flow of the ship exemplifies an enabled capacity operating under command.
Holding and restraining the sky supplies preservation through a continuously maintained limit.
Tender compassion identifies the sustaining mechanism as care rather than impersonal mechanics.
Life as benefit makes the focus the most intimate instance of the preceding services.
Concealing benefit directly negates the gratitude response established by the contextual pattern.

structural_cues: 22:36 links sakhkhara lakum to la'allakum tashkurun.
22:65 repeats sakhkhara lakum and leads directly into the focus's same divine subject.
22:66 answers the gratitude expectation with emphatic la-kafur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful service, enabled motion, restraint, compassion, and an explicit gratitude aim; I infer that the focus adds biological existence to this maintained system. The live alternative is to read 22:66 as a separate eschatological summary rather than the culmination of these dependencies.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports three isolated divine feats and then a generic rebuke.
changed_reading.after: It culminates a field of ongoing support: even present life and mortality are administered dependencies, so kafur is a direct reversal of the gratitude those supports solicit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel should produce hearts that bind perception into understanding, yet the packet locates blindness in hearts; later, denial of clear signs is itself recognizable on faces. These cues activate insan as sensing and kafur as an operation that covers what has become perceptible.

activation_trace.role: Human sensing and noticing supplies the capacity whose reversal the context diagnoses.
Covering supplies the active occlusion laid over available perception.
The heart as inward faculty becomes the actual site where perception succeeds or fails.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance gives travel and perception their intended cognitive effect.
Blindness of heart names the blocked uptake that can coexist with functioning eyes.
Recognition from a visible trace makes denial itself legible rather than hidden.
Rejection of truth embodies the focus's coverer response when clear signs are recited.
The opposite of recognition turns the face into evidence of a refused acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 22:46 contrasts working eyes and ears with blind hearts.
22:72 places clear signs, facial recognizability, kufr, and munkar in one visible reaction.
The focus juxtaposes the perceptive human root with an emphatic covering predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed inward perception and externally recognizable denial; I infer that the insan branch of sensing is intentionally activated by the focus's adjacency to kafur. The live alternative is that insan remains only a species noun and the perceptual wordplay is secondary.

changed_reading.before: Ingratitude is an unexamined disposition unrelated to how signs are received.
changed_reading.after: Kafur becomes a perceptual act: the sensing human covers an intelligible life-death-life pattern until nonrecognition becomes visible in conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet explicitly chains being killed or dying to apportioned provision and then to entry into a place of satisfaction. This gives the focus's second enlivening a supplied quality: death is a passage into renewed reception, not merely an interval followed by bare reanimation.

activation_trace.role: Actual taking of life supplies one concrete route into the promised post-death sequence.
Loss of life supplies the other route, directly repeating the focus's middle state.
Apportioned giving makes what follows death a positive reception rather than an empty survival.
Ingress into an interior supplies a spatial realization of passage beyond death.
Satisfaction rather than displeasure qualifies the destination of that ingress.
Restored animate life receives the provision-and-entry content activated by the earlier sequence.

structural_cues: 22:58 uses thumma before killed-or-died and immediately promises provision.
22:59 continues that promise with entry and satisfaction.
22:66 repeats death followed by life under the same divine agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies death followed by provision, entry, and satisfaction; I infer that this sequence specifies the experiential quality of the focus's revived life. The live alternative is that the migrant promise is a distinct reward scene and only confirms survival after death.

changed_reading.before: Revival means only animation after biological death.
changed_reading.after: Revival also carries the shape of renewed reception: after dispossession by death comes apportioned provision, ingress, and satisfied life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fly parable tests two powers: originating even minimal life and recovering what has been taken. Both seeker and sought fail, whereas the following verse marks divine force as concentrated strength. The focus's causatives therefore describe unmatched control over origination, withdrawal, and recovery of life.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a creature into existence supplies the first capability that false powers cannot perform.
Extraction from another's grasp supplies the failed recovery test after something is taken.
The opposite of strength diagnoses both parties as lacking effective power.
Measuring something to its proper limit supplies the failed human appraisal of divine capacity.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies the positive contrast to creaturely weakness.
Withdrawal of force identifies what only the focus's subject can govern and reverse.
Origination and restoration of animate life answer both failed tests in the parable.

structural_cues: The branchless root س ل ب at 22:73 word 20 marks something taken that the invoked powers cannot recover.
22:73 tests creation and recovery with the smallest animate example in the passage.
22:74 immediately contrasts failed appraisal with divine strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed origination, failed rescue after loss, weakness, and divine strength; I infer that these are practical tests of the agency asserted in the focus. The live alternative is that the parable only attacks idolatry without retroactively specifying the life-death-life verbs.

changed_reading.before: The focus asserts power abstractly through a remote sequence.
changed_reading.after: The sequence defines power operationally: true sovereignty can originate life, let it be taken, and recover it from a state no dependent power can reverse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night is inserted into day and day into night rather than merely placed after it. That reciprocal ingress activates a process reading of the focus: mortality enters present life, and renewed life emerges through death, while the explicit thumma sequence still preserves distinct thresholds.

activation_trace.role: One thing entering the interior of another supplies reciprocal transition rather than simple replacement.
The split-root image of massing darkness sharpens the nightward phase that penetrates daylight.
Night as the dark contrary of day supplies one member of the reciprocal pair.
Day opening through light supplies the returning phase that emerges from darkness.
The two animate-life poles receive the contextual image of light returning through its contrary.
Death remains a distinct loss of life even while the context activates interpenetrating transition.

structural_cues: 22:61 states A entering B and then B entering A in a balanced reversal.
The focus gives life, then death, then life with repeated thumma.
The shared divine subject governs both reciprocal cosmic transition and the human sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal ingress of dark and light; I infer an analogy in which mortality is already entering life and life is recoverable through death. The materially live alternative is a strictly discrete chronology with no overlap between the focus's states.

changed_reading.before: Life, death, and life are three sealed chronological blocks.
changed_reading.after: They remain ordered thresholds but may also be heard as governed transitions that enter and disclose one another, like night and day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a nonbiological death branch inside the causative yumitukum. It remains anchored in the explicit death branch of yielding to truth, the life branch of benefit, and the contextual lowing and guidance of hearts. Downstream prose should mark it as an ethical metaphor that coexists with, and does not replace, bodily death and resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative death-then-life construction at words 5 and 7 can carry an exploratory ethical modulation alongside its biological sequence.

activation_trace.role: Death as submission to truth supplies an ego-level yielding rather than bodily cessation.
Life as benefit and good supplies restored ethical usefulness after yielding.
A low, level tract supplies the contextual image for hearts becoming lowered and receptive.
The heart supplies the inward site where lowering can become a changed mode of life.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies the transition from yielded self-force to useful life.

changed_reading.before: God causes only bodily death and later bodily revival.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing that reading, the line can also image the death of resistant self-force followed by revival as receptive, beneficial life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because the tribal sense belongs to hayy as a social noun while the focus uses causative life verbs. It remains worth carrying because the object pronouns are plural, al-insan is generic singular, and focus branches connect life, human sociability, and mutual disavowal. Downstream prose should present it only as a social analogy beneath the primary individual and eschatological reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Plural -kum recipients across the three verbs are gathered under the generic singular al-insan before the final relational covering predicate.

activation_trace.role: Hayy as a kin-group or tribe supplies a form-distant image of collective vitality and reconstitution.
Sociability that removes estrangement supplies the relational medium in which a human collective lives.
Disavowal and mutual dissociation supply the social failure that can dissolve acknowledged dependence.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns only each individual's biological trajectory.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, it can also evoke social bodies receiving vitality, undergoing dissolution, and being reconstituted while humans disavow the relations that sustain them.

strongest_changes: The sakhkhara-to-shukr pattern in 22:36 and the maintained services of 22:65 turn la-kafur into a direct reversal of expected gratitude for ongoing dependence.
The dry-earth, water, movement, growth, and greenness sequences in 22:5 and 22:63 make ecological latency a live coexisting model for life-death-life.
The death-to-provision-to-satisfying-entry chain in 22:58-59 gives revived life positive content beyond bare reanimation.
Heart-blindness and recognizable denial in 22:46 and 22:72 sharpen insan-kafur into a paradox of perception followed by active occlusion.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several nonexclusive mechanisms at once: sovereign chronology, modulation of borrowed force, cultivated latency, perceptual self-occlusion, maintained dependence, and death as passage into renewed provision. The odd readings remain explicit and contained rather than being flattened into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The farmer and fruit-cover senses of kafur are strong branch resonances but do not by themselves establish that the surface predicate means farmer or sheath.
The force-modulation and submissive-death readings are metaphorical extensions and must not erase bodily death and resurrection.
Reciprocal night-day ingress supplies an analogy for transition, not an explicit claim that life and death are temporally simultaneous.
The collective-life outlier depends on a noun-specific hayy branch and should remain subordinate to the individual reading.
